title: Zindaan se chut ke
body:
Zindaan se chut ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Aa gaye sadaat, aa gaye sadaat
karbala aa gaye sadaat..(2)
Uthiye hussain aapke zawwar aaye hai
zindaa'n se chut ke abid e beemar aaye hai..(2)
1. Bhoole nahi hai shaam aur koofe ke raaste
tarse hue hai maula ye matam ke waaste
sab kuch luta ke aapke ghumkhwaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Zainab ne chalte naaqe se khud ko gira diya phir kohniyo se chalke gayi bhai se kaha
humlog hoke koocha o bazaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Gardan pe aur jismpe zanjeer ke nishaa'n
ek ek zakhm dard ki kehta hai dastaa'n
zindaa'n se zinda laut ke lachaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Jee khol kar yaha tera matam karenge hum
karbobala mein majlis e chehlum karenge hum
aye maula shaam wale azadaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Zindaa'n mein ek teri azadaar reh gayi
karbobala na aayi na zindaa'n se ghar gayi
dafna ke usko abid e beemar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Zindaa'n mein karke aaya hai majlis ye karwaa'n
sab bibiya'n thi matami zainab thi nawhakhwaa'n
mehwe buka o deeda e khoo'n khwaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Aisa safar batool ki beti ne tay kiya
dete nahi the log aseero ko raasta
tay karke saari manzil e dushwaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Be dard the wo shaam aur koofe ke sab makee'n
tang hogayi thi aale mohammad pe ye zamee'n
sadaat hoke jeene se bezaar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Farhan o mazhar abidi kyu na ho nauhagar
sajjad chutke qaid se baba ki qabr par
lekar nishane tauqe garo baar aaye hai
<<MINI>>
zindaa'n se chut ke..
